verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own features point toward acting on many emails at once. The homepage promises to identify important emails with a single click and "sweep away the rest". AI filters automatically label, star and archive mail using plain-English scripts. A hands-on user cleared a weeks-old backlog in about 10 minutes, and another praised grouping/bundles and "mark as done". However, no documentation explicitly describes multi-select bulk actions or asking the AI to apply one operation across a large set of existing threads, so the depth of bulk support is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/multi-select actions, AI-driven bulk operations on existing threads (e.g. archive or label everything matching a query), scale or limits documentation.
